open:
<button
          onClick={onBack}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl chat-tile flex items-center justify-center text-[#90C9F0] flex-shrink-0"
        >

<button
          onClick={() => setMenuOpen((v) => !v)}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl chat-tile flex items-center justify-center text-white/60 flex-shrink-0"
        >

<button
            onClick={sendMessage}
            disabled={!input.trim()}
            className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-sm transition-all flex-shrink-0 ${
              input.trim() ? "bg-[#86d1ea] text-[#072E49] arena-glow" : "bg-white/10 text-white/30"
            }`}
          >

<button
        onClick={() => onReply?.(msg)}
        className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 self-end active:scale-95 transition-transform overflow-hidden"
      >

<button
                onClick={() => setMenuOpen((v) => !v)}
                aria-label={t("chat.messageActions")}
                aria-expanded={menuOpen}
                className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm leading-none transition-colors ${
                  menuOpen ? "bg-white/15 text-white" : "bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >

<button
              key={c}
              onClick={() => setColor(c)}
              aria-label={c}
              className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full transition-all ${color === c ? "ring-2 ring-white ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0E0C] scale-110" : "opacity-80"}`}
              style={{ background: c }}
            />

<button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#1B2419] flex items-center justify-center text-[#bfc8cc] flex-shrink-0"
          >

<button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#1B2419] flex items-center justify-center text-[#bfc8cc]"
          >

<button
              onClick={quickAdd}
              className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${
                isAdded
                  ? "bg-green-500/15 border-green-500/30 text-green-400"
                  : "bg-[#90C9F0]/10 border-[#90C9F0]/30 text-[#90C9F0] active:bg-[#90C9F0]/20"
              }`}
              title={isAdded ? t("home.addedSlip") : t("home.addToSlip", { name: game.team1.abbr })}
            >

<button
        onClick={() => inSlip ? removeLeg(bet.id) : addLeg({ ...bet.leg, probability: displayPct })}
        className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center text-sm flex-shrink-0 transition-colors ${
          inSlip
            ? "bg-green-500/15 border-green-500/30 text-green-400"
            : "bg-[#90C9F0]/10 border-[#90C9F0]/30 text-[#90C9F0] active:bg-[#90C9F0]/20"
        }`}
      >

<button
        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); }}
        aria-label={t("pred.playerBackToStats")}
        title={t("pred.playerBackToStats")}
        className="w-8 h-8 flex-shrink-0 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-[#8a9ea6] bg-[#0A0E0C] border border-white/15 transition-transform active:scale-95"
      >

<button
            onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
            aria-label="Back"
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#131A12] border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
            style={{ color: ACCENT }}
          >

<button
          onClick={() => stepMonth(-1)}
          disabled={curIdx <= minIdx}
          aria-label="Previous month"
          className="w-9 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all disabled:opacity-25"
          style={{ color: accent }}
        >

<button
          onClick={() => stepMonth(1)}
          disabled={curIdx >= maxIdx}
          aria-label="Next month"
          className="w-9 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-all disabled:opacity-25"
          style={{ color: accent }}
        >

<button
            onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#131A12] border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
            style={{ color: accent }}
          >
